entities.summary: Ryan Matthew Lilja is an American former professional football player who was a center and guard in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Kansas State Wildcats, and signed with the Kansas City Chiefs as an undrafted free agent in 2004, and later played with them from 2010 to 2012. Lilja also played with the Indianapolis Colts from 2004 to 2009, with whom he won Super Bowl XLI over the Chicago Bears.
